header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner; nor intimation received.
body: Perusal of prayer clauses reflects that instant Petition was only filed for issuance of directions to the official respondents to provide protection to the petitioner.
Learned A.A.G while filing comments of respondents No.2 and 3, submits that official respondents will provide protection to the petitioner as per law.
In view of above, instant petition is disposed of with direction to the official respondents to provide protection to the petitioner as and when required and to act strictly in accordance with law.
